evidence.claim: Umbragroup produce viti a ricircolo di sfere per l'aeronautica e l'industria con stabilimenti in Italia, Germania e Stati Uniti.
evidence.quote: Today UMBRAGROUP is the world leader in the manufacture of ball screws in the aeronautics sector and one of the main players in the industrial market || With plants in Italy, Germany, and the United States || the Group ’s focus is on serving the following businesses worldwide: Aircraft manufacturers; Integrated systems manufacturers; Airlines; Machine tool manufacturers.
